title: praxis.integration-contract/1
description: The integration contract of parallel workstreams, read by `praxis streams check` from the `integration` member of ros.json (or from --contract FILE). See docs/work-protocol.md, 'Integrating parallel workstreams'.

target.description: The ref streams integrate into. Default: the upstreamSync remote-tracking branch (refs/remotes/origin/main). --against overrides it.

managedPaths.description: Paths merged by tooling (for example .ros/**, merged by `praxis work history merge`). Neither owned nor counted as overlap; reported separately.

commonPaths.description: Paths any stream may change without an approval. Overlap on them is still reported.

glob.description: A repository-relative path glob: * and ? within a segment, ** across segments (Ordo's MutationBoundary glob).

workItem.description: The work item the stream is bound to.

ref.description: The stream's branch or ref; a name that does not resolve is also tried under refs/remotes/<upstream remote>/.

ownsPlannerArea.description: Ownership is the work item's planner.areas entry in ros.json (each path owns itself and everything below it), not re-declared here.

dependsOn.description: Streams that must be integrated first. Hard planner.dependencies between bound work items are added.

requiredTests.description: Tests the stream must pass before merging. Evidence is a work.completion.verified event at the tip; otherwise each is reported unverified.

artifacts.description: Expected output artifacts: each glob must match a path at the stream tip.

owner.description: The stream that may change the interface freely.

paths.description: Within the interface; default the whole interface.

decision.description: A Decision Record that must exist at the integration target.

approvedBy.description: The approver, recorded in the contract.
